name: ubiquitin conjugating enzyme E2 T

function.text: UBE2T encodes ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme E2 T. Annotated molecular activities include ubiquitin-protein transferase activity and ubiquitin conjugating enzyme activity. It participates in DNA repair and protein autoubiquitination.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Fanconi anemia complementation group T (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: UBE2T encodes ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme E2 T. It accepts ubiquitin from the E1 complex and catalyzes its covalent attachment to other proteins. It participates in mitomycin-C (MMC)-induced DNA repair. It functions as a specific E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme for the Fanconi anemia complex by associating with E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase FANCL and catalyzing monoubiquitination of FANCD2, a key step in the DNA damage pathway.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Fanconi anemia complementation group T (autosomal recessive).
